viewing_check: Read the grey gilt book's spine and title page: confirm it is Rackham's Fairy Tales of the Brothers Grimm (Constable 1909 first trade edition is the valuable one; later Constable/Doubleday printings are worth far less) and check for the 40 colour plates with tissue guards and a red top edge. Check copyright pages of the Milne books (first printing 1924 only matters) and the Robinson (1903 date, plates complete). Check for loose or missing plates, library marks.
